text_block_list.text:
Before the race, when I visited the waiting room,
Air Groove was trembling ever so slightly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool, it is the exact opposite.
I am having the time of my life.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"For this will bring me one step closer
to proving that I can serve as a role model
for all the world's Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious...? Witness the running of the "Empress", and keep your eyes peeled!
